skills.grammarMd:
The present tense is **di-** + the verb’s present stem + a personal ending:

| | çûn (go) | kirin (do) |
|---|---|---|
| ez | diçim | dikim |
| tu | diçî | dikî |
| ew | diçe | dike |
| em, hûn, ew | diçin | dikin |

The stem is often not what the dictionary form suggests, so learn the **ez** form with each verb: *dîtin → dibînim* (see), *gotin → dibêjim* (say), *dan → didim* (give), *zanîn → dizanim* (know).

**hatin** (come) has no di-: *ez têm, tu têyî, ew tê, em tên*.

A place you go to takes -ê and needs no preposition: *Ez diçim bazarê.* I am going to the market.

skills.grammarMd:
Four verbs you will use every day:

- **xwestin** want: *ez dixwazim, tu dixwazî, ew dixwaze, em dixwazin*
- **xwarin** eat: *ez dixwim, tu dixwî, ew dixwe, em dixwin*
- **vexwarin** drink: *ez vedixwim, tu vedixwî, ew vedixwe* — the **ve-** stays in front of di-
- **karîn** can: *ez dikarim, tu dikarî, ew dikare*

The object comes before the verb: *Ez nan dixwim.* I am eating bread. · *Tu çay vedixwî?* Are you drinking tea? · *Hevalo sêv dixwaze.* Hevalo wants an apple.

**ji … hez dikim** is “I like”: *Ez ji penîr hez dikim.* I like cheese.

skills.grammarMd:
To say *not*, put **na-** where **di-** was:

- *Ez diçim → Ez naçim.* I am not going.
- *Ew dixwe → Ew naxwe.* He isn’t eating.
- *Tu têyî → Tu nayî.* You aren’t coming. (hatin: *nayêm, nayî, nayê, nayên*)
- *vedixwim → venaxwim* — ve- stays in front.

Two verbs take **ni-**: *nizanim* I don’t know · *nikarim* I can’t.

With the copula use **ne**: *Ez ne birçî me.* I am not hungry.

**hîç** is *(not) at all*: *Ez hîç nizanim!* I have no idea!

lines.text: Xalo… li ser devê wî çi heye?
lines.en: Uncle… what is that on his mouth?

lines.text: Li ser devê wî? Ev… ev sêv e.
lines.en: On his mouth? This… this is apple.

lines.text: Û bersiva te, xalo?
lines.en: And your answer, uncle?

lines.text: Bersiva min? Ez dikenim! Mîrza jî dikene.
lines.en: My answer? I’m laughing! And Mîrza is laughing too.

lines.text: Mîrza, pereyê sêvan li ser min e!
lines.en: Mîrza, the apples are on me!

lines.text: Bar giran e, Bozo, lê mal nêzîk e.
lines.en: The load is heavy, Bozo, but home is near.

lines.text: Xalo, telefona te!
lines.en: Uncle, your phone!

lines.text: Lorîn e! Xwişka min, ji Kobaniyê…
lines.en: It’s Lorîn! My sister, from Kobanî…

lines.text: Ew çi dibêje?
lines.en: What is she saying?

lines.text: Nîvê wêneyê me li cem wê ye!
lines.en: The other half of our photo is with her!

lines.text: Li Kobaniyê? Bi rastî?
lines.en: In Kobanî? Really?

lines.text: Erê! Û diya me dibêje ku hûn hemû tên!
lines.en: Yes! And our mother says you are all coming!

lines.text: Em hemû? Ez jî?
lines.en: All of us? Me too?

lines.text: Tu jî, Xezal jî… û Hevalo jî!
lines.en: You too, Xezal too… and Hevalo too!

lines.text: Kîjan roj?
lines.en: Which day?

lines.text: Di dawiya hefteyê de. Bar giran e, lê dilê min sivik e!
lines.en: At the end of the week. The load is heavy, but my heart is light!
